# Import the data
```{r}

diabetes_data_num <- read_csv("/Users/richard/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-UniversityofSaskatchewan/CHEP898/finalpaper/data/final_data_recoded.csv")

```

# convert variables to factor
```{r}
diabetes_data_factor <- diabetes_data_num %>%
  mutate(across(c(sex, bmi_cat, sight, memory, walk, deaf, metropolis, marital, education, employment, ethnicity, age_grp, physical_health, mental_health, last_checkup, exercise, heart_attack, stroke, asthma, ever_depression, ever_arthritis, dm_type, dm_education), as.factor))
```

# Split the dataset into training and test sets
```{r}
set.seed(1123581321)

data_split <- initial_validation_split(
  diabetes_data_factor,
  strata = dm_type, 
  prop = c(0.6, 0.05)) 

train_data <- training(data_split)
test_data     <- testing(data_split)

```
